card.name: Units and pieces in dose or size phrases
card.fires_on: Words that name a single piece or amount (tablet, doses, cut, x, least) inside dosing, splitting or measurement phrases. It fires on the word right before a number, size or quantity limit.

modes.label: Tablet as a unit
modes.description: The word tablet after a determiner or adjective, in handling or formulation statements.
modes.example: No<< tablet>> should be ingested if it is broken

modes.label: Dose or size wording
modes.description: Words like doses, x, or a decimal point that lead into a numeric amount or dimension.
modes.example: Valsartan was without grossly observable adverse effects at single oral<< doses>> up to 2000 mg

modes.label: Cutting or dispensing verbs
modes.description: Verbs about cutting or dispensing that come before a quantity or size.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd word fragments and away from batch and block-size terms, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on words for one piece or amount, like tablet or doses, just before a number or size.
